name: kerbside
title: Kerbside
description: A street-food theme that letters the menu like the cut-vinyl panel beside a serving hatch: every dish in huge rounded white capitals on ultramarine truck paint, its price the same size ranged right, the small print on white strips, and a checker-plate step for a footer.

tokens.--font-vinyl: the cut-vinyl lettering: dish names and prices, the site title, menu links, page titles, headings, section names, dates, pitch labels, table headings, the button, the links under a list, the footer name
tokens.--font-body: running text and the small print on the strips
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--weight-vinyl: how heavy the vinyl lettering is cut
tokens.--size-vinyl: the one queue-reading size shared by every dish name and price on the panel, on a dish's own page and on the 404
tokens.--size-title: size of page titles, and of post titles in the news list
tokens.--leading-vinyl: line spacing of the lettering wherever it runs to a second line — dish names, prices, page and post titles, headings, pitch labels, the button, the site title; loose enough that an accent on a capital never meets the line above
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capital labels: menu links, section names, dates, table headings, the smallest headings in page text
tokens.--color-bg: page background: the truck paint (also the gap inside the button's keyline, and the button itself on hover and on focus)
tokens.--color-text: the lettering: dish names, prices, section names and the rule beside them, headings and body text on the paint, and links on hover
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the paint: dates, table headings, the page count
tokens.--color-accent: links on the paint and list markers
tokens.--color-seam: the panel seams: the rule over each band, under the masthead, between pitches, over the links under a list, and hr; also the ring of shadow round each rivet
tokens.--color-rivet: the heads of the rivets under each seam, and the lines between table rows
tokens.--color-strip: the white vinyl strips: descriptions, pitch values, the current menu link, the home page's welcome stripe, quotes, code, tags, the skip link, selected text, the button and its keyline, image borders
tokens.--color-strip-link: links on a strip, and the button's lettering
tokens.--color-plate: the checker-plate footer, and the plain patch under its words
tokens.--color-plate-hi: the lit face of each raised lozenge on the plate
tokens.--color-plate-lo: the shadow of each lozenge, and the edge along the top of the plate
tokens.--color-focus: the outer focus ring, seen on paint and plate
tokens.--color-focus-edge: the inner focus ring, seen on strips
tokens.--measure: maximum width of running text, of a post's cover and of the footer's words
tokens.--measure-wide: maximum width of the lettering column inside the full-width bands
tokens.--gutter: space between the lettering and the edge of the screen
tokens.--keyline: weight of the button's keyline and of the gap inside it, of image borders and of the focus rings
tokens.--radius-strip: corner rounding of the strips, the menu links and the focus ring
tokens.--radius-cut: corner rounding of the button and of images
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between menu links, between a pitch label and its strip
tokens.--space-2: small gap: above each band, above and below each pitch row, under a section name or a date, between a description and its price
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs, the padding under a band, and the gaps in the home page's pitch list
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, above headings and page titles, between the home page's panel and its text, and the padding of the footer
tokens.--space-5: large gap under the last text of a page
